seoTitle: Text Box Drawer: ASCII Boxes and Code Comment Banners
metaDescription: Draw a box around text with single, double, rounded, heavy or ASCII borders, or wrap it as a // /* */ # comment banner for code.
intro: Put a neat frame around text for READMEs, terminals and source-code headers.
why:
Choose a border style, alignment and padding. Box styles use Unicode box-drawing characters or plain ASCII; comment styles wrap each line with //, /* */ or # and add rules above and below. The width is measured in characters so the box lines up in monospace fonts.

Unicode box characters need a monospace font that includes them; use the ASCII style for maximum compatibility.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Pick a border style and alignment.
Copy the result into your document or code.

faq.a: The font may not be monospace or may lack box-drawing characters; use the ASCII style.
Wide characters can misalign boxes in some fonts.
Use the ASCII table generator for tables.
